task.title: Adding a new image tag to an image by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To create an alias for an existing image, you can add a new tag to it from the Repositories page of the Red Hat Quay v2 UI. The new tag points to the same image and appears immediately in the repository’s tag list.

step.cmd: On the Red Hat Quay v2 UI dashboard, click Repositories in the navigation pane.
Click the name of a repository that has image tags.
Click the menu kebab, then click Add new tag.
Enter a name for the tag, then, click Create tag.

info.p: The new tag is now listed on the Repository Tags page.
